body.label: Effect
body.html: Choose one creature or unsecured object within 7 units. On a success, move it up to 4 units.

surges.html: Ignore line of sight for one target you can otherwise locate within this card's range.
On a success, move one affected creature or unsecured object 1 unit.

rider.title: PROJECTION — STRAIN
rider.html: If you gained Strain while resolving this Action, increase its range by 2 units.
